top_choice_rationale: P004 pairs the one mature synthetic-methods case with clean attribution, Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (Buchwald and Hartwig, each with a general catalytic version built on new ligand classes and used daily in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis), with base editing for Liu, where the chemical novelty is programmable single-base deamination without double-strand cleavage and an evolved adenine deaminase. It uses three names with no arbitrary cut. P001 is next because it shares the Liu part and its narrowed Crews/Deshaies degrader citation is one I could accept; P006 follows as the cleanest single credit but a thinner prize; the zeolite and cereblon-inclusive degrader proposals come after because of citation-scope cuts, and condensates and no award last.
